title: Blockscene
failed: Could not load the catalog. Close and try again.
insertFailed: Could not create this component. Use the native picker and report its schema.
example: Images are examples; appearance depends on your frontend.
settingsIntro: Gallery thumbnails, wireframe palette and editor preferences. Changes apply the next time the gallery opens; no rebuild is needed.
brokenMedia: The selected media no longer exists; the next source is used.
enabledHelp: Off restores the native picker and accordions. This page stays available to turn it back on.
states.remember: Remember the last open/close all action
rememberHelp: Only the explicit open all / close all buttons update the memory, per user and browser. Opening one block does not.
previewUrlHelp: Full URL of your frontend page-preview route, e.g. https://site.test/block-preview/page. Leave empty to reuse the origin of Strapi's native Preview (when configured for the content type) with /block-preview/page. The route must implement the bridge (see README).
previewModeHelp: Every edit view opens in this mode, unless its content type sets its own below. Editors can switch while they edit; the switch is not remembered.
previewV4: The whole-page preview is available in the Strapi 5 distribution only; these options have no effect on Strapi 4.
previewHelp: Unsaved changes appear in the preview. Click a block to open its form, an image to open the Media Library, a text to edit it.
previewNoUrl: No preview URL: set it in Settings, Blockscene, or configure Strapi's native Preview for this content type.
previewFailed: The preview did not answer within 15 s. If the frontend is still loading it will appear by itself; the form stays usable.
editHelp: Unsaved changes: "Apply" updates the form and the preview; saving and publishing stay in the panel.
editUnsupported: This field has no editor in this dialog; edit it in the form.
blockPreviewInForm: Show preview above fields in form mode
blockPreviewInFormHelp: In form mode an expanded block shows a compact, collapsible read-only preview of its unsaved values above its fields. Side by side and preview modes never show it; the page preview is where editing happens.
zoneFull: The zone already has its maximum number of blocks.
insertMoved: Could not insert at that position; the zone changed.
disabledByServer: BLOCKSCENE_DISABLED is set on the server. The native editor is forced until the server restarts without it.
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.
diagTitle: Block groups need attention; publishing is refused until they are fixed:
diagCloseBeforeOpen: Row {n}: close marker "{uid}" has no open marker before it.
diagMismatch: Row {n}: close marker "{uid}" does not match the open group "{open}" (expected "{expected}").
publishBlocked: Publishing is refused while block groups are unbalanced.
diagSummary: {count, plural, one {# block group problem} other {# block group problems}}; publishing is refused until fixed
diagStrayHint: Remove the stray marker with the row's own delete action, or move it after an open marker.
publishDisabledHint: Publishing is unavailable: save first, fix the errors shown in the form, or check your permissions.
showFieldsHint: Show the field list on each block
contentTypesHelp: The gallery, accordions and page preview work on these content types (the ones with a Dynamic Zone). Turn one off to leave its edit view native. "Opens in" is how every edit view of that type starts; editors can still switch while they edit.
